name: groove
description: A single skill for every coding task: it takes the task you name, writes only what something uses, cuts the rest before finishing, and reports the check that passed.

interface.shortDescription: Every coding task, with only the code it needs
interface.longDescription: Groove carries a coding task from request to report. It takes the task you name, plans rebuilds and large work in one file first, names a caller before writing anything new, cuts what nothing needs before finishing, keeps tests to a few seconds, and reports numbers it counted.
defaultPrompt: Use Groove to fix this bug.
Use Groove to rebuild this project.
